newsitem.title: USA: Elscint coinsidence detection gets FDA nod.
newsitem.headline: Elscint coinsidence detection gets FDA nod.

text.p: Elscint Ltd said on Monday it has received approval from the Food and Drug Administration for its so-called coinsidence detection enhancement for its Varicam variable angle gamma cameras.
In a statement from its headquarters in Haifa, Israel, the company said the enhancement "will add premium capabilities to the already very high performance standards of the Varicam."
Elscint is ready to begin deliveries of the enhancement, said Jonathan Adereth, president and chief executive of the medical imaging equipment manufacturer.
"We believe it will increase demand for Varicam, which reached record sales levels in our fourth quarter," he said.
The enhancement should also improve profit margins in the company's nuclear medicine product line, which suffered declining profitability in the past, he added.
